verdict.rationale: Fireflies supports webhook notifications (e.g., a webhook URL for transcription completion in uploadAudio, and webhook-based Zapier integration for fetching transcripts on completion), showing webhook subscription capability exists, but documentation is thin — there's no dedicated webhooks/event-subscription API reference describing event types, payload schemas, or a general subscription management endpoint. missing for 10: a comprehensive webhooks API doc listing subscribable event types and payload formats, first-party docs beyond the single uploadAudio callback and Zapier mention, independent corroboration of reliability.
